title: Manifest toolchain lock
description: Content-addressed provisioning lock for manifest provision. Every tool entry names the artifact kind, its per-platform source, a sha256 that a real download must satisfy, and an exe_sha256 that is the sole trust anchor toolchain.resolve() verifies the materialized executable against (never the store's own manifest.json). An entry with sha256 or exe_sha256: null is unattested and must resolve to BLOCKED, never PASS.

sha256.description: Hash of the downloaded archive/binary, verified by manifest provision before extraction.

exe_sha256.description: Hash of the materialized executable itself -- the trust anchor `toolchain.resolve()` verifies at every preflight. Null is unattested and must resolve to BLOCKED, never PASS; the store's own manifest.json is never trusted for this value.

console_scripts.description: python-env / node-env only: console-script relative paths hashed after materialization.
